messages.site.game.guestIntro: You are playing as a guest. Your progress is encrypted and saved in this browser. You can also save manually from the System menu.
messages.site.game.guestRisk: Clearing site data or using a private window may lose your progress. These characters are not available in another browser, on another device or at a different website address.
messages.site.game.guestOffline: While online, the game checks its connection and version. Downloaded content remains playable offline. Maps and assets you have not downloaded need a connection; use the System menu to download the full offline resources.
messages.site.game.guestCloud: Google sign-in and cloud sync are not available yet. Your saves are not uploaded.
messages.site.game.unconnected: Not connected · Local play is available
messages.site.storage.format: This save has an unsupported format. The original data has been kept.
messages.site.storage.integrity: The save could not be decrypted or verified. The original data has been kept.
messages.site.storage.transaction: Saving was interrupted. The original data has been kept.
messages.site.storage.secure: Encrypted saves require a secure connection. Open the game over HTTPS.
messages.site.storage.missingKey: The local encryption key is missing, so this save cannot be read. The original data has been kept.
messages.site.storage.invalidKey: The local encryption key is invalid. Your saved data has not been changed.
messages.site.storage.load: Game content could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again. Your local saves are safe.
messages.site.storage.open: Local saves could not be opened. Your data has been kept.
